## Future City Scan (FCS)

Forward-looking indicators from the Future City Scan pipeline (SSP scenarios).
Figures are produced by the `fcs` task and stored separately under
`03-render-output/fcs/`; underlying tables carry the `_fsca` suffix.

```{r}
#| label: setup-fcs
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/fcs/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-fcs
#| include: false

fcs_plot_dir <- here::here("03-render-output", "fcs", "plots")
fcs_plots <- if (dir.exists(fcs_plot_dir)) {
  list.files(fcs_plot_dir, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
} else character(0)

# Friendly captions, in the order we want them presented.
fcs_caption_map <- c(
  "urbanland_trend_fsca"     = "Urban land fraction by SSP, 2010-2100",
  "population_by_ssp_fsca"   = "Population by SSP (2020)",
  "cckp_precipitation_fsca"  = "CCKP precipitation anomaly by SSP",
  "cckp_temperature_fsca"    = "CCKP temperature anomaly by SSP"
)

fcs_read <- function(pattern) {
  f <- list.files(tabular_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)[1]
  if (!is.na(f) && file.exists(f)) {
    tryCatch(read_csv(f, col_types = cols()), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else NULL
}
fcs_urbanland <- fcs_read("urbanland_fsca\\.csv$")
fcs_pop       <- fcs_read("popdynamics_fsca\\.csv$")
```

```{r}
#| label: fcs-figures
#| results: asis

if (length(fcs_plots) == 0) {
  print_text(paste_bold("No FCS plots available — run `scan fcs` for this city."))
} else {
  # Present known plots in curated order, then anything else that exists.
  stems  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fcs_plots))
  ordered <- c(intersect(names(fcs_caption_map), stems),
               setdiff(stems, names(fcs_caption_map)))
  for (stem in ordered) {
    f <- fcs_plots[stems == stem][1]
    if (is.na(f)) next
    cap <- if (!is.null(fcs_caption_map[[stem]])) fcs_caption_map[[stem]] else stem
    cat("\n\n### ", cap, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n\n", cap, normalizePath(f, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fcs-tables
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(fcs_urbanland)) {
  cat("\n\n### Urban land fraction by SSP (table)\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(fcs_urbanland %>% print_paged_df()))
  cat("\n\n")
}
if (!is.null(fcs_pop)) {
  cat("\n\n### Population by SSP (table)\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(fcs_pop %>% print_paged_df()))
  cat("\n\n")
}
if (is.null(fcs_urbanland) && is.null(fcs_pop)) {
  print_text(paste_bold("No FCS tables available."))
}
```
